'''Tabletop Simulator''' is a virtual tabletop program by Berserk Games, sold on Steam.<ref name="store" /> Fan-made, unofficial Workshop tables let two players play [[Star Wars CCG]] on it. Players move the cards themselves, as on [[Holotable]]. The HiRez Workshop description points players who want a program that understands the rules to [[GEMP]].<ref name="hirez" />

[[File:Star Wars CCG HiRez Light Side playmat.jpg|thumb|right|400px|HiRez Light Side playmat, with [[Chewie With Bowcaster]] in play.<ref name="hirez" />]]

== Star Wars CCG (HiRez) ==

The Workshop table with the fullest stated card pool is [https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2900102719 Star Wars CCG (HiRez)] ([steam://url/CommunityFilePage/2900102719 Open in Steam]), posted by [[Tolban]] on 10 December 2022 and last updated on 6 November 2024.<ref name="hirez" /> It includes all original [[Decipher]] cards and [[Players Committee]] virtual cards through [[Virtual Set 23]].<ref name="hirez" /> Later virtual sets, from [[Virtual Set 24]] through [[Virtual Set 27]], were published after that update.

[[File:Star Wars CCG HiRez Dark Side playmat.jpg|thumb|right|400px|HiRez Dark playmat, with [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]].<ref name="hirez" />]]

The table provides playmats with buttons for Activate, Use, Re-circulate and Draw, user-configurable hotkeys, searchable card names, a deck generator for booster packs, starter decks and set lists, and a deck importer.<ref name="hirez" /> The first time the table is loaded, the card images are downloaded, which the description says can take quite some time.<ref name="hirez" />

[[File:Star Wars CCG HiRez Deck Generator.jpg|thumb|right|400px|HiRez Deck Generator, with starter decks and booster packs.<ref name="hirez" />]]

== How to import a deck ==

A paid copy of Tabletop Simulator on Steam is required. Subscribe to the HiRez Workshop item and open the table.<ref name="store" /><ref name="hirez" />

[[File:Star Wars CCG HiRez Deck Importer.jpg|thumb|right|400px|HiRez Deck Importer, Dark Side Battle of Hoth.<ref name="hirez" />]]

The Deck Importer accepts two kinds of list:<ref name="hirez" />
* A [[GEMP]] deck, exported from GEMP's Deck Builder as XML and pasted into the importer. The Light and Dark buttons can be ignored for GEMP XML.
* A plain-text list whose card names are written as in the Scomp-Link Database, with a leading or trailing multiplier such as 4x or (x4). The first line is treated as the deck title. The Light or Dark button must be set for a plain-text list.

If the Errata box is selected, the importer uses corrected versions of cards that have errata; otherwise it uses the original Decipher cards.<ref name="hirez" />
